messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT P1 - Tenant 'AtlasCorp' reporting generation quality regression after quantization roll (dedicated pool dp-az-3). Pager sent to oncall-eng and oncall-ml. Ticket INC-2026-0452 created.
oncall-eng: I'm on it — acknowledging. Can someone paste the customer report and the exact config that changed?
oncall-ml: Ack. Brief summary from support: AtlasCorp started seeing summaries truncate and factual errors ~30m after our scheduled qprofile rollout. They are on Dedicated (dp-az-3) with VPC peering.
omar: CS saw the customer convo — their legal-summaries endpoint returned many incomplete bullets. They flagged it to their SRE and asked for rollback. Customer severity: high, revenue-impacting.
jessica: Thanks. I see the rollout job for `qprofile-v2-optim` succeeded on dp-az-3 at ~1772002100. Logs show converged quant kernels: `int4-gptq` applied to model `redwood/gptq-7b-v2`.
raj: Adding context: `qprofile-v2-optim` tightened quant ranges to reduce cost. We observed a small drop on canary last week but below alerting threshold. Looks like AtlasCorp workload distribution (longer prompts, legal templates) exposed degradation.
oncall-ml: Customer isolation confirmed: only AtlasCorp on dp-az-3 was affected (no cross-tenant contamination). Impact metrics from observability: 
- 85% of AtlasCorp generation calls had ROUGE-L drop >= 0.12 vs baseline
- Latency unchanged
- Token error rates unchanged
These indicate quality regression rather than runtime failure.
sarah: Oncall SRE here — confirm tenant isolation, no infra faults. We should avoid moving their traffic off the pool (VPC + certs). Propose revert quant profile for AtlasCorp only (tenant-scoped override).
oncall-eng: Agreed. What's the safest revert command? Can deploy-bot run a tenant override?
deploy-bot: I can execute the tenant profile change. Command preview: 
```
redwoodctl tenants update --tenant atlascorp --quant-profile qprofile-v1-stable --model redwood/gptq-7b-v2 --reason "emergency revert due to quality regression"
```
Note: this performs a tenant-scoped override; does not affect other tenants on dp-az-3.
ivan: Support will prepare message to AtlasCorp after we revert. Need ETA for fix.
jessica: Proposed plan: 1) Run tenant override to qprofile-v1-stable (rollback) 2) Pin model variant to previous non-quantized fallback for 60m for verification 3) Run quick evals on customer's prompt set 4) Notify customer and lift pin when metrics stable.
oncall-ml: I like it. One caveat: pinning to non-quantized increases cost; inform CS.
omar: I'll notify AtlasCorp: expected revert in ~10min, we'll follow up with results and potential increased cost for the short pin. CS ticket CS-7893 created.
sarah: I'll open a temporary alert for AtlasCorp quality metric so we can watch regressions come back down: alert name `atlascorp.quality.recovery`.
raj: Executing step 1 now (tenant-scoped revert). Running `redwoodctl` call via deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: Executing... 
```
> redwoodctl tenants update --tenant atlascorp --quant-profile qprofile-v1-stable --reason "emergency revert due to quality regression"
Success: tenant atlascorp quant profile set -> qprofile-v1-stable (applied to dp-az-3 resources)
Deployment ID: dep-1772004389
```
oncall-eng: Good. Now step 2: pin model variant. Command: 
```
redwoodctl tenants pin-model --tenant atlascorp --model redwood/gptq-7b-v1-unq --duration 3600
```
raj: Pin executed. `pin-id: pin-1772004410`
oncall-ml: Running quick evals against AtlasCorp sample prompts (10 items) now. Results incoming.
noncall-ml: Eval results: 9/10 items match pre-roll baseline, ROUGE-L delta median < 0.02. Looks like rollback fixed quality for these samples.
omar: Notifying AtlasCorp now (CS message): "We've reverted a quantization change for your tenant and temporarily pinned the prior model variant. We're monitoring and will follow up in 30 min with detailed metrics. Apologies for the disruption."
ivan: Customer acknowledged, asked for a short RCA and whether this will recur.
sarah: For immediate safety, we should block further qprofile-v2-optim rollouts to dp-az-3 until postmortem. I'll add a temporary block: `rollout-blocks dp-az-3 add qprofile-v2-optim`.
jessica: Done. Also flagging a regression ticket for the ML team to investigate quantization sensitivity for long-context legal prompts: REG-2026-312.
oncall-ml: Next steps: full eval on 200-case prompt set, analyze quantization bit allocations and per-layer MSE, consider qprofile adjustments (less aggressive clipping).
raj: I'll collect kernel-level stats and the per-layer calibration histograms and attach to the incident.
oncall-eng: Do we need to escalate to Eng leadership or keep within oncall+ML+CS? Omar, what's AtlasCorp's expectation?
omar: They want an RCA and assurance this won't happen again. CS requests an exec summary but not immediate escalation — they appreciate the quick revert.
ps: (automated) Created internal follow-up task: TASK-1772 - "AtlasCorp qprofile regression postmortem" assigned to raj, due 2026-03-22.
sarah: Can we extend the pin to 4 hours if metrics remain stable? Prevents flapping during analysis.
oncall-ml: Yes, extend to 4h. I'll also run a targeted canary of a tuned qprofile variant `qprofile-v2-soft` on a synthetic subset before any wider rollout.
raj: Pin extended (pin-1772004410 -> expiry updated).
ivan: Customer updated: appreciates quick rollback and asks for timeline for permanent fix. Suggested message: "We'll run a thorough analysis, propose safe qprofile adjustments, and schedule a patch rollout subject to your approval." Omar to send.
omar: Sent. They asked to keep them in the loop for any future rollouts.
jessica: Post-incident checklist: 
- Confirm revert persisted across restarts (sarah)
- Collect detailed eval artifacts (raj)
- Draft RCA and mitigation plan (jessica + raj)
- Customer comms summary (omar)
- Preventive rollout gating (sarah)
sarah: I'm verifying revert persists. System shows config persisted and no drift.
oncall-eng: Closing live mitigation loop: quality back to baseline on sample checks; customer notified; blocking rollout to affected pool. We'll triage REG-2026-312 as high priority.
pagerbot: Incident INC-2026-0452 status -> mitigated; root thread will remain open for postmortem artifacts. :white_check_mark: 
jessica: Thanks team. Postmortem owners: raj (ML analysis), jessica (RCA doc), sarah (ops controls), omar (customer follow-up).
raj: Saving logs and artifacts under /incidents/INC-2026-0452/artifacts. I'll include quantization calibration plots, eval outputs, and kernel stats.
omar: CS will follow up with AtlasCorp tomorrow with the RCA draft.
ivan: Marking customer impact resolved for now. Will reopen if they report additional regressions.
oncall-ml: One action item: add a canary workload specifically simulating AtlasCorp prompts to our pre-rollout test harness. REG-2026-312 will include that.
sarah: I'll run a retrospective in on-call channel after the RCA. Good job on the quick revert everyone."
